Package org.apache.cayenne.access.translator.ejbql

Class DbAdapterDelegatedEJBQLTranslator

java.lang.Object
org.apache.cayenne.access.translator.ejbql.DbAdapterDelegatedEJBQLTranslator
All Implemented Interfaces:
EJBQLTranslator
public class DbAdapterDelegatedEJBQLTranslator extends Object implements EJBQLTranslator
An EJBQLTranslator that resolves the actual translator from DbAdapter.getEjbqlTranslator() allowing adapters to customize translation. The adapter is obtained from the EJBQLTranslationContext.
Since:
5.0
